content.title: "Chaos Rising" Prerelease Promos Revealed! - PokeBeach
content.text: #2 Depends on the rest of the kit, but goodra being able to ohko everything probably makes it the best? Then crobat in second since its easier to set up and the confusion could be helpful. #4 Delphox seems pretty decent. If you manage to pull the normal Deoxys you could use it's first attack a few times to get more energy into play. It's also totally possible to charge a Mega floette which gets a bunch of energy in play. But you could also use the Book of Transformation to switch Deoxys with Floette, and it wouldn't be to hard to get set up because you have 40 cards in the deck and Delphox's ability. #5 Okay this time I really hope to get to do a pre-release event. They quickly sell out near me. #6 Without knowing the rest of decks, I think the only thing I'd argue is that Ampharos is the worst of the 4. Goodra hits the most consistent number but needs 2 energy types. Delphox needs there to be 5-6 energy on the board in total, but that's not terribly difficult given any deck not Crobat's gonna want to have 3 energy on the board at any given point their attacker might get KO'd. Crobat comes down to how much switchpower decks are given, if any. All the other big attackers have 2+ retreat. Stacking a card on top of deck is never a bad effect. Ampharos's only advantage is that this might be a build and battle deck that can get Judge naturally. #7 not a prerelase question, but do y'all think crobat Kang is a serious draw engine or nah? #8 not a prerelase question, but do y'all think crobat Kang is a serious draw engine or nah? In a dedicated kang deck sure but as an engine not at all coz you'd need to promote crobat, then somehow switch to kang THEN retreat to your actual attacker. Ns Zoroark, Drakloak, Rapidash even can draw that card from the bench. Pecharunt ex will be the main combo piece for moving the bat around #9 not a prerelase question, but do y'all think crobat Kang is a serious draw engine or nah? Absolutely not. People have tried so hard to make it work in japan, and it just doesn't. Theoretically, with Pecharunt ex and Air Balloon, you can have Crobat function like Smooth Over Magcargo, but its so much setup. A stage 2, tool, and a basic ex is a lot of work for what's basically a Pidgeot ex that forces Kang to be in the active and gives you a bonus topdeck. Not to mention, if Crobat or the squishy fighting-weak Pecharunt ex goes out the engine is ruined. Like TrainerSkitz mentioned, you can use something like Rapidash, Zoroark, or Drakloak, but that just throws another line you need up into the mix. That's more than half your bench dedicated to dollar store Pidgeot, and if a single one of them dies you're boned. If there's any that MAYBE have a chance it's N's Zoroark who already uses Pecharunt ex and doubles as the draw requirement, but the fact that not a single person has made top 16 in a city league with it (where the standards are much lower) is pretty telling imo.
